title: Benchmarks
hints: A benchmark has the signature func BenchmarkXxx(b *testing.B). Like t.Run for tests, b.Run(name, func(b *testing.B) { ... }) creates a named sub-benchmark.
Since Go 1.24 the body of a benchmark loop is written for b.Loop() { ... }. The framework decides how many iterations to run.
b.Run("plus", func(b *testing.B) { for b.Loop() { JoinPlus(parts) } }), and the same for "builder" with JoinBuilder. Try go test -bench . -benchmem in your workspace to compare them.
